summary: Faz 3 Chart Preview enhancement — POST /api/excel/{id}/chart-data endpoint + RechartsChart.jsx + Önizle/Yenile buttons in ExcelModal Charts tab. Backend: added 13 new tests to /app/backend/tests/test_excel.py (TestExcelChartData) covering auth, isolation, sum/mean/count aggregations, y-omitted → size(), non-numeric y → count fallback, missing sheet/x/y → 400 with exact Turkish detail, limit clamping (1..200), agg aliases (avg→mean). Full suite = 34/34 PASS in 122s. Frontend: uploaded 10-row Turkish xlsx as serkan, opened ExcelModal, switched to Grafik tab → 5 LLM-suggested chart cards (column/line/bar/scatter/pie) rendered with data-testid chart-suggestion-{i}. Clicked Önizle-0 → live recharts SVG rendered in chart-canvas-0 with 1 rect (bar). Canvas-1 (line): 1 path + 5 dots (circles). Canvas-2 (bar): rects. Canvas-3 (scatter): 10 path dots. Canvas-4 (pie): 5 labeled slices. Button label correctly toggled 'Önizle'→'Yenile' after loading; clicking Yenile re-fetches and SVG persists. Screenshots confirm cyan Sertex theme (axis stroke #67e8f9, colored bars, dot markers). Error path verified via direct fetch: bad column → 400 with Turkish detail 'X sütunu bulunamadı' (or 'Sayfa bulunamadı' when sheet name mismatches openpyxl default 'Sheet').
critical_code_review_comments: excel_service.py chart_data(): _AGG_MAP normalises sum/mean/avg/average/count/min/max/median correctly. Non-numeric y with agg=sum silently falls back to count (agg field also reflects 'count' in response — verified). NaN → 0 for y, NaN → None for x. datetime x correctly isoformat-ed. Sort desc + limit head — matches spec.

excel_router.py chart_data_endpoint: max(1, min(req.limit, 200)) clamps limit range. ValueError → 400 with str(e) preserves the Turkish detail from chart_data() (X sütunu bulunamadı / Y sütunu bulunamadı / Sayfa bulunamadı) — verified via tests.

excel_router.py: chart-data endpoint reuses _load_owned_workbook — same ownership + category=spreadsheet + 401/403/404/400/502 guards as the other 5 endpoints. DRY. Cross-user still returns 404 (verified).

RechartsChart.jsx: cyan Sertex theme (#22d3ee, #38bdf8, #60a5fa, ...); ResponsiveContainer height=260; supports bar/column/line/area/scatter/pie; empty-data guard renders 'Bu grafik için veri yok.' — solid defensive rendering.

ExcelModal.jsx loadChartData(): agg selection heuristic (pie/bar/column/area/line → sum, else mean) is reasonable. chartDataMap keyed by suggestion index — no collision. chartLoadingIdx guards concurrent clicks. Button label 'Önizle'/'Yenile' toggle is derived from chartDataMap[i] presence — clean.
lib/api.js excelApi.chartData(id, params): thin wrapper over POST /excel/{id}/chart-data. Consistent with the other excel methods.
MINOR observation (non-blocking): ExcelModal.jsx is now 545 lines — still cohesive but approaching split threshold. Consider extracting Charts tab into a subcomponent in a future iteration.

MINOR observation (non-blocking): Runtime error overlay 'Cannot close a closed AudioContext' appears in dev mode from a pre-existing STT/TTS code path — unrelated to Faz 3 chart preview, but it can visually intercept clicks in dev; consider guarding audioCtx.close() with a state check.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chart-data endpoint is fully covered by TestExcelChartData in /app/backend/tests/test_excel.py. Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_excel.py -v -n 2 (uses parallel workers; ~120s total). Frontend: openpyxl-generated xlsx has sheet name 'Sheet' (not 'Sheet1'); when writing chart-data requests, first fetch analyze to read the actual sheet name from data.schema[0].sheet — this is what ExcelModal.loadChartData does via the suggestion's c.sheet field. LLM chart suggestion latency can occasionally exceed the k8s ingress timeout (~60s) causing 502; retrying works. Pre-warming via direct fetch to /charts is a reliable workaround for playwright flows.
